transfer_tasks.prompt: Your students keep forgetting new words. What would you do to address this problem?
transfer_tasks.model_answer: I would address the problem with short, consistent review activities.
hints: Use address with a problem or issue.

transfer_tasks.prompt: Describe one way to make a difference in your English learning this week.
transfer_tasks.model_answer: I can make a difference by reviewing a few useful expressions every day.

readings.title: A Better Way to Learn English
readings.source: Original sample written for this app
readings.text:
Learning a language takes time, but practice does not have to be complicated. You can read a short story, notice a useful expression, and then try to recall it without looking.

Reviewing your answers helps you discover what you remember and what still needs practice. Small, consistent efforts can become a meaningful habit.

questions.prompt: What is the main idea of this passage?
options: Small, consistent practice supports language learning.
Language learning should always be complicated.
questions.answer: Small, consistent practice supports language learning.

questions.prompt: What can a learner do after noticing a useful expression?
questions.model_answer: Try to recall it without looking.
